function doGet(e) {
  return handleRequest(e);
}

function doPost(e) {
  return handleRequest(e);
}

function handleRequest(e) {
  var sheet = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().getActiveSheet();
  var params = e.parameter;
  var action = params.action;

  var headers = {
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*" // Benarkan akses dari mana-mana
  };

  if (action == "get_bookings") {
    var data = sheet.getDataRange().getValues();
    var bookings = [];
    // Skip header row
    for (var i = 1; i < data.length; i++) {
      if (data[i][0]) { // Check if ID exists
        bookings.push({
          id: data[i][0],
          room: data[i][1],
          teacherName: data[i][2],
          className: data[i][3],
          subject: data[i][4],
          timeSlot: data[i][5],
          date: data[i][6],
          dayOfWeek: data[i][7],
          weekId: data[i][8],
          createdAt: data[i][9]
        });
      }
    }
    return ContentService.createTextOutput(JSON.stringify(bookings)).setMimeType(ContentService.MimeType.JSON);
  }

  if (action == "create_booking") {
    var payload = JSON.parse(e.postData.contents);
    sheet.appendRow([
      payload.id,
      payload.room,
      payload.teacherName,
      payload.className,
      payload.subject,
      payload.timeSlot,
      payload.date,
      payload.dayOfWeek,
      payload.weekId,
      payload.createdAt
    ]);
    return ContentService.createTextOutput(JSON.stringify({status: "success"})).setMimeType(ContentService.MimeType.JSON);
  }
  
  return ContentService.createTextOutput(JSON.stringify({error: "Invalid action"})).setMimeType(ContentService.MimeType.JSON);
}
